text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text:
Wow, there are so many snakes...!
It's impossible to defeat them one by one... It's such a hassle.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわ、
ヘビがいっぱい……っ！
これ
一匹ずつ倒していくとか
無理だよね……
めんどさ的に。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text:
I'll wipe them out with my handmade gigantic bomb!
...But they're slithering around too much!
I have to gather them in one spot somehow...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私お手製の特大爆弾で一網打尽にしてやるわ！
……って
ニョロニョロ動き過ぎよ！
なんとか一箇所に集めないと……！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
Okay, leave that to me!
I might be good at this kind of thing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
オッケー、
それなら私に任せて！
そういうのなら得意かも！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
Hey everyone~! It's Nozomi from Carmina~!
Thanks for gathering here today~♪
We're going to have a guerrilla live in the cave~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっほー
みんなー！　
カルミナのノゾミだよ～！
今日は集まってくれてありがと～♪
今からゲリラライブ・イン・洞窟
やっちゃうよ～♪

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text:
Oh~ they're gathering~!
As expected of an idol~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おお～
集まってきた～！
さすがアイドル～！
